event_chain.summary: Compromised credentials used on data exchange platform

summary: In July 2026 Swiss train maker Stadler Rail confirmed that the Everest gang used compromised credentials to access a file-sharing/data exchange platform used with a third-party supplier and stole Stadler technical documents. Everest demanded CHF 10 million (about $12.3 million) in an extortion letter; Stadler refused, filed a criminal complaint and said no personal data was stolen, its own systems were unaffected and production continued.
